subject: Request: hosting carveouts + discount clearance for MediSys VPC
messages:
From: Aisha Qureshi <a.qureshi@medisys.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: joe.simmons@medisys.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot: hosting carveouts and audit window request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed. We want to move forward with a 6-month pilot for our MLR workload but need a few non-standard items in the MSA and SOW to proceed:

- Limited audit window: Medisys can request evidence (SOC2 reports, access logs) but only during a scheduled quarterly review with 10 business days notice. No live hands-on audits or on-prem-style inspections.
- Data residency carveout: Customer-managed VPC in us-west-2, with retention controls and optional bring-your-own-key (BYOK).
- Deployment constraints: Our security team requires that only certain IP ranges are used and that KV cache logs are retained for 30 days.
- Commercial: we need a pilot discount to align with budgeting — target 25% for the first 6 months.

Attached: Medisys_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf with redlines on audit scope. Please let me know what you can accept and what needs escalation. We have procurement and legal on standby.

Thanks,
Aisha Qureshi
Senior Procurement Manager
MediSys Health
[attachment: Medisys_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Qureshi <a.qureshi@medisys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: hosting carveouts and audit window request

Summary of next steps from our side:
1) I'll coordinate pricing and commercial flexibility with Ben.
2) Marissa (legal) will review the questionnaire and propose tightly scoped audit language.
3) If we need an exception to standard audit rights or >15% discount, this will go to our Deal Desk / Execs — I will escalate.

Ben / Marissa — please see Aisha's asks attached. Ben, can you run a pilot pricing proposal today? Marissa, initial read?

Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[phone: +1 415 555 0192]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 13:47:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot: hosting carveouts and audit window request (pricing sketch)

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:03 AM Olga Petrov wrote:
> Ben / Marissa — please see Aisha's asks attached. Ben, can you run a pilot pricing proposal today?

Quick commercial proposal for discussion:
- Pilot length: 6 months, capped at 2M tokens per month.
- Proposed pilot discount: 20% off list for first 6 months.
- One-off onboarding credit to cover engineering work (SOW item) — $25k.
- Payment: Net 30 with PO; require a refundable true-up if usage > committed.

Why 20%: we can give up to 15% under standard comps; anything >15% requires Deal Desk/Exec approval.

Audit & hosting carveouts (commercial impact):
- Limiting audit to SOC2 evidence and access logs is reasonable; full onsite audits are not acceptable for hosted customers.
- Allow BYOK and VPC peering limited to approved IP ranges — needs engineering signoff and an SOW line item.

Attachments: rough SOW (SOW-hosting-carveouts.xlsx) and a price calc.

If OLGA thinks we need an exec signoff for the discount and audit carveouts, I'll write the ask with recommended language.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOW-hosting-carveouts.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: legal_ops@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot: hosting carveouts and audit window request — redline summary

Thanks Ben. Quick legal read:
- Discount: Commercial can set up to 15% at my authority. Anything above that is an exception and requires Deal Desk review + VP signoff.
- Audit language: Accept SOC2 reports, access logs, and periodic exports only. We must prohibit any on-site or live interactive audits for hosted offerings. Proposed language in attached redline: Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II reports, aggregated access logs, and a data export on 10 business days' notice; any additional audit activity will require a court-subpoena or mutual agreed scope in a separate SOW.
- BYOK / KMS: Acceptable with enrollment in our KMS partner flow; must be in SOW with crypto key handling procedures.

I attached a redline for the MSA and show the specific clause changes (Redwood_MediSys_MA_Platform_Redline.docx). Please review — if we need >15% or to accept the proposed quarterly audit timing, this needs to go to Rishi for exec clearance.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_MediSys_MA_Platform_Redline.docx (docx)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: EXEC ESCALATION: Request clearance for 20% pilot discount + limited audit carveouts (MediSys)

Rishi — quick escalation and ask. MediSys (large regional health system) is ready to sign a 6-month pilot but requires: 1) a 20% pilot discount for budgeting, and 2) narrowly scoped audit access (quarterly scheduled reviews, 10 business days notice, SOC2 & access logs only; no onsite/live audits). They will host in a customer-managed VPC (us-west-2) and require BYOK support.

Impacts:
- Revenue: 20% discount is above our standard authority (Marissa can approve 15%); Ben models the EBITDA impact as acceptable for a strategic healthcare reference.
- Product/Eng: We need a short SOW for VPC onboarding, IP allowlist, and KMS flow. Estimated engineering ops + onboarding $25k.
- Legal/Risk: Marissa's proposed redline limits audit exposure; primary ask is exec clearance to accept the quarterly scheduled audit language and to permit up to 20% pilot discount.

Ask: Please confirm by EOD today if you will approve: a) one-time pilot discount up to 20% and b) acceptance of the proposed audit carveout language in Marissa's redline. If partial approval, please indicate limits (e.g., discount cap, required mitigations).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/deal/DEAL-2026-4097
DocuSign preview: https://app.docusign.com/contracts/ABC-123
Attachments: redline + sq

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_MediSys_MA_Platform_Redline.docx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, finance_ops@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: EXEC ESCALATION: Request clearance for 20% pilot discount + limited audit carveouts (MediSys)

Olga — thanks for the clear ask and the docs. I approve conditional clearance: 

1) Discount: approve up to 18% (not 20%) for the 6-month pilot. Finance will issue the discount code and we will capture the concession in the deal record.
2) Audit carveout: accept Marissa's redline language limiting audit to SOC2 reports, access logs, and scheduled data exports with 10 business days' notice. Explicitly prohibit on-site/live forensic inspections for hosted deployments. Marissa — please put the final wording in the DocuSign packet.
3) Engineering mitigations: require a short SOW that lists IP allowlist ranges and BYOK enrollment steps and a $25k onboarding fee. Ben — coordinate with ProdEng and include the SOW line items.
4) CISO review: require a quick CISO sign-off on the final redline before DocuSign (48-hour SLA).

If those conditions are met, proceed and finalize the pilot. Good work — this is a high-value strategic reference.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
